import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    P = list(map(int, data[1:1+N]))

    bit = [0] * (N + 2)

    def update(i):
        while i <= N:
            bit[i] += 1
            i += i & -i

    def query(i):
        s = 0
        while i > 0:
            s += bit[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return s

    sum_pp = 0
    for i in range(N):
        v = P[i]
        s = i + 1
        # B_v = number of values greater than v seen so far (at positions < s_v)
        b = i - query(v)
        update(v)
        p = s - b
        sum_pp += p * (p - 1)

    sum_vv = N * (N - 1) * (N + 1) // 3
    print((sum_vv - sum_pp) // 2)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
